name: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: The best chocolate chip cookies - soft, chewy, and packed with chocolate chips!

recipeInstructions.text: Combine flour, baking soda, and salt in a small bowl.
Beat butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla extract; beat well.
Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes; remove to wire racks.
